verdict.interpretation: Decisive empirical resolution: While significant patient heterogeneity exists (sigma^2 = 2.34, p < 1e-10), the within-patient baseline hazard shape parameter remains dramatically below unity (alpha_within = 0.5854 << 1.0). Furthermore, 85.1% of independent multi-episode patients independently exhibit alpha_i < 1.0. This proves that early AF entrenchment is a genuine physiological property of individual AF episodes, not a statistical artifact of between-patient frailty sorting.
